_comment: Editable defaults. Numbers marked 'aggregator' are order-of-magnitude, not measured by us. Replace with your own: run llama-bench / ollama run --verbose and read power with `sudo powermetrics --samplers gpu_power` (macOS) or `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw --format=csv` (NVIDIA). Prices are street prices in USD at review date.

mac-mini-m4-pro-64gb.label: Mac mini M4 Pro, 64 GB
mac-mini-m4-pro-64gb.source: Apple pricing; power: Jeff Geerling M4 mini measurements (system) — model-specific W is an estimate

mac-studio-m4-max-128gb.label: Mac Studio M4 Max, 128 GB
mac-studio-m4-max-128gb.source: Apple pricing; load W estimate from llama.cpp discussion #4167 class machines (aggregator)

mac-studio-m3-ultra-256gb.label: Mac Studio M3 Ultra, 256 GB
mac-studio-m3-ultra-256gb.source: Apple pricing; skorppio.com DGX-Spark-vs-Mac-Studio bench peak 370 W (aggregator)

strix-halo-128gb.label: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 mini-PC, 128 GB
strix-halo-128gb.source: hardware-corner.net single data point; W estimate

models._comment: decode tok/s per hardware key; quality_tier is an *assumption* about which cloud tier the model plausibly replaces for coding-agent work (haiku|sonnet|opus). Open models rarely match frontier quality.
